description: Several GEO cohorts participated in feature screening and therefore are not fully independent external validation cohorts.
candidate_implication: Any retained or rebuilt model must reconstruct discovery roles and reserve genuinely independent cohorts before claiming external validation.

description: Exact sample filters, probe mapping, z-scoring, cutoff, baseline survival, and author analysis code are missing.
candidate_implication: Exact reproduction and absolute-risk validation are blocked; use prespecified sensitivity choices and verified code donors.

description: The nerve-related label was derived from a broad gene list and does not directly measure nerves, neural activity, or nerve density.
candidate_implication: Candidates retaining a neural interpretation need orthogonal neural evidence; otherwise the claim must be renamed or downgraded.

description: The in-house single-cell cohort is controlled and its official description is inconsistent with the NRRS paper.
candidate_implication: The in-house cohort cannot be indispensable; public alternatives or a lower claim are required.

description: The treatment cohorts do not establish a gastric treatment interaction or predictive biomarker claim.
candidate_implication: Drop treatment-benefit claims unless a suitable treated-versus-untreated or randomized interaction dataset is found.

description: The baseline hazard and transportable preprocessing and cutoff needed for absolute-risk prediction are not reported.
candidate_implication: Limit public reconstruction to relative risk or association unless model-complete information is recovered.
